mapper.sql: eqp_id, oper_state, since_at, reason_code, reason_detail, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_eqp_oper_state (eqp_id, oper_state, since_at, reason_code, reason_detail) VALUES (#{o.eqpId}, #{o.operState}, /* since_at NOT NULL 안전 처리 */ COALESCE(#{o.sinceAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{o.reasonCode}, #{o.reasonDetail})
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_eqp_oper_state SET oper_state = #{o.operState}, since_at = COALESCE(#{o.sinceAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, since_at), reason_code = #{o.reasonCode}, reason_detail = #{o.reasonDetail}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE eqp_id = #{o.eqpId}
